title: ClassPass vs Gym Membership in NZ — Which Saves More Money?
meta_desc: Compare ClassPass and gym membership costs in NZ. Discover which option saves you more money with our expert guide.
intro: With the rising cost of living in New Zealand, it's essential to choose a fitness membership that suits your budget. ClassPass and traditional gym memberships are two popular options, but which one offers better value for money? Let's dive into the details and compare the costs.

sections.heading: How ClassPass Works
sections.body: ClassPass is a subscription-based fitness platform that allows users to attend classes at various studios and gyms across New Zealand. The platform uses a credit system, where users purchase a set number of credits per month, which can be redeemed for classes. The cost of ClassPass in NZ starts at $49 per month for 3 credits, with each credit valued at around $15-$20 per class.

sections.heading: Real Cost at NZ Studios
sections.body: The cost of classes at NZ studios varies greatly, with some studios charging as low as $10 per class and others charging up to $30 per class. For example, a yoga class at Yoga House in Auckland costs around $20 per class, while a strength training class at F45 in Wellington costs around $25 per class.

sections.heading: ClassPass vs Gym Membership: Price Comparison
Best Use Cases for ClassPass and Gym Membership
sections.body: ClassPass is ideal for those who enjoy variety in their workout routine and want to try different classes and studios. On the other hand, a dedicated gym membership is better suited for those who have a consistent workout routine and prefer to use the same equipment and facilities regularly.

sections.heading: Get the Best Value for Your Money
Specific Gym Membership Options
sections.body: If you're looking for a dedicated gym membership, consider options like Les Mills NZ, which offers a 12-month contract for $69.95 per month. Alternatively, you can check out our detailed guide to Anytime Fitness NZ, which offers a 12-month contract for $79.95 per month.
